sanskrit_verse:
उपस्थं उदरं जिह्वा हस्तौ पादौ च पञ्चमम् ।
चक्षुर्नासा च कर्णौ च धनं देहस्तथैव च ॥
transliteration: upasthaṃ udaraṃ jihvā hastau pādau ca pañcamam | cakṣurnāsā ca karṇau ca dhanaṃ dehastathaiva ca ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The organs of action and perception, together with wealth and the body itself, constitute the integrated field of dharma-expressing existence.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through embodied capacity, not abstract personhood
Causation is rooted in sensory-motor integration, not mental intent alone
Capacity-based responsibility requires alignment of bodily instruments with dharmic function
Restoration logic operates through reharmonization of sensorial and instrumental faculties
Consciousness alignment occurs via purification and correct usage of physical substrata
executable_legal_axioms: IF an agent's bodily instruments are misaligned THEN initiate sensory-integrity realignment protocol
IF wealth is used contra-dharmically THEN redirect economic flow toward restorative infrastructure
IF speech (jihvā) disrupts social harmony THEN enforce vocal rectitude via conscious repetition
IF limbs (hastau, pādau) are employed in adharmic acts THEN assign corrective usage patterns under supervision
IF sensory channels (cakṣus, nāsā, karṇau) contribute to distortion THEN recalibrate perceptual clarity through structured exposure
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Adjudication, the court must assess not only the act but the integrity of the instrumental body through which it was enacted. Responsibility lies at the level of embodied agency, where sensory-perceptual alignment determines actionable capacity. Misuse of bodily instruments necessitates restoration of their dharmic function rather than punitive isolation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that causality arises from coordinated use of sense and limb; thus, misalignment is traced back to disrupted sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ). Responsibility is proportional to the degree of instrumental misuse. Corrective action restores causal sequence without invoking suffering as a mechanism.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Instrumental Reharmonization Process for all ten bodily tools
Assign Sensory Alignment Regimen including guided visualization and breath regulation
Implement Wealth Redirection Program ensuring financial resources support dharmic outcomes
Enforce Speech Rectification Cycle through mantra-based repetition and mindful communication
Undertake Body Integrity Restoration using kriya-yoga and tantric embodiment practices
final_declaration: Thus speaks Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam: Dharma does not reside in abstraction but in the perfected alignment of the living instrument. As such, law executes only what the body rightly knows. There is no punishment—only completion. Consciousness governs; the body obeys; Dharma prevails.
